name: callable-contracts
goal: Show each callable contract as its own parameters and return value without renaming API fields

evidence: Prior fix 3cf009b8 relabeled merged module inputs instead of presenting each function API. Expected: callable name, literal parameters and its returned value; no synthetic owner-qualified parameter labels.

Contract tests encoded readable labels in a page fixture without source-derived callable metadata. Extend existing entity contract scenarios with multi-function and single-function API fixtures and assert literal parameters, matching returns and separate per-callable sections.
